course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: HTTP and safe boundaries
goal: Design a bounded HTTP contract and test success, rejection and timeout against a local mock.

prerequisites.text: onec.p10; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: Exchange is an external boundary
paragraphs: An HTTP request crosses into another participant’s failures and lifecycle. Specify method, path, body schema, response codes and size limits. A connection is not an accepted request; a 200 with a malformed body also fails the application contract. Do not send real data to public teaching services.

This advanced exercise uses only an own 127.0.0.1 с портом собственного mock service, not a learner-controlled arbitrary host or Nexus. Inspect native/full-support/http-pedagogy-mock.mjs in the extracted source kit: loopback-only GET and synthetic responses. No tokens or real data.

sections.title: Policy selects addresses
paragraphs: A user-suppliedURLmust not grant server code arbitrary internal-network/file access. Use a fixed loopback mock without secrets; it is not a production endpoint. RealHTTPSrequires certificate validation and redirect policy. DisablingTLSvalidation to make tests green is unacceptable.

Node.js from its official distribution is needed only for this extra HTTP exercise. In PowerShell at the kit directory run node native/full-support/http-pedagogy-mock.mjs mock-ready.json. Require the own process readiness file; if the port is occupied and startup fails, never contact the unknown service. Beginner labs need no such setup.

Open the mock-ready.json produced by your process in a text editor. Replace НомерПортаИзСвоегоMockReady in the caller with its numeric port value; the marker is not a predefined BSL variable. The host remains 127.0.0.1.

sections.title: Responses can be ambiguous
paragraphs: A timeout after sending does not reveal whether the remote side accepted the request. Blind retry can duplicate work. Use a requestIDand verification/retry policy. Distinguish transport failure, business 4 xx, temporary 5 xxand schema failure. Log safe IDs rather than tokens or complete payloads.

Append the complete BSL to server common module УчебныеПрофессиональныеОпыты. Call ОпытHTTP from the existing startup handler and print all three result fields. Save, F7 and run: health gives 200 plus own-service marker, reject gives 400 and slow raises a 1-second timeout. No response creates a request document.

sections.title: A case that distinguishes the wrong solution
paragraphs: The mock exits after three minutes; Ctrl+C may stop only its own terminal process. Remove the startup call and retain all observations. The 4096 check is after string materialization, not a streaming network limit. This local test does not prove HTTPS, redirect policy, arbitrary-host SSRF protection or real external integration.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Success is inferred from an unavailable environment. Separate actual observations from a planned advanced scenario and name edition limits.
A failed attempt is removed to make the record look successful. Retain the original failure, its cause, correction and regression evidence.
An own-copy change is applied over the accepted original. Verify the actual directory and preserve source identities before making changes.

selfcheck.prompt: Does HTTP 200 alone establish business success?
Investigate the separate adverse case without claiming an unavailable environment was tested. After the admitted run stop the own mock and call BSL again.
selfcheck.feedback: Accepted original preserved; rejection and its limits explained.

practice.task: Investigate the separate adverse case without claiming an unavailable environment was tested. After the admitted run stop the own mock and call BSL again.
practice.environment: Separate own synthetic infobase; retain the prior module and its backup. Studio and Sandbox optional.

steps.title: Preserve the starting state
steps.action: Close Enterprise. Export a DT backup from Administration → Dump infobase; restore it into a new empty directory and verify the actual path. Preserve earlier functions/fields.
steps.expected: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.
steps.troubleshooting: A new list name alone does not create another database directory.
steps.before: Own path, prior sources and a restorable backup identified.

steps.title: Add the complete server source
steps.action: Create a server/server-call module without Global or Privileged. Paste the complete source below outside other procedures; retain a single shared preparation function if already present.
steps.why: Database access has an explicit server boundary.
steps.expected: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not paste definitions inside startup or into an arbitrary Studio file.
steps.before: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.

steps.title: Prepare and call the experiment
steps.why: Print every named result instead of accepting compilation alone.
steps.expected: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.
steps.troubleshooting: Keep one startup handler; ensure the common module is server-call enabled.
steps.before: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.

steps.title: Save, update and run once
steps.action: Run once and compare the fields with the worked trace. 1-second timeout; No false success.
steps.why: Observe actual 1C data, not the browser diagram.
steps.troubleshooting: Record the first failed assertion and module/line. Do not change the expectation merely to get True.
steps.before: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.

steps.title: Retain both results
steps.action: Remove only the startup call. Use another copy for the adverse case and keep both protocols.
steps.why: Preserve provenance and avoid repeating data creation at every startup.
steps.expected: Original retained, negative experiment isolated, automatic caller removed.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not clear registers or delete old documents to make a total agree.
